description:
Relevant Experience  (in Yrs) 6+  
 Minimum 1 year prior Investran application experience as an end user, technical support or consultant  
 Advanced technical skills in Excel & VBA developing macros  
 Minimum 2 year of full project life cycle experience implementing an Investment and/or accounting based application  
 Minimum 2 years practical experience with SQL including complex stored procedures  
 Minimum 2 years practical experience with Business Intelligence Reporting Tools (Crystal Reports, SSRS, XML). Experience must include report design and development.  
 Minimum 2 years practical experience with .NET environments  
 Minimum 2 years practical experience with the Software Development Life-Cycle  
 Must be detailed oriented and have the ability to multi-task and set priorities.  
 Ability to work independently and be productive (meets deadlines / flexible / responsive to change).  
 Good written and verbal communication skills.  

 Program Specifications and Interface Control Documents – responsible for updating existing documentation or creating new documentation when new functionality or reporting is added.  
 Business Automations – responsible for analyzing and converting business process flow utilizing Excel OLE DB & Excel macro functions.  
 Analyzing current business processes, defining work flow and completing gap analysis in respective business areas requirements and able to develop recommendations to solve for local or regional requirements.    
 Working with technical and business personnel to write detailed specifications for reporting, systems requirements, use cases, and design documents.  
 Report Development – Documents business requirements and develops reports utilizing SSRS / Crystal Reports / Excel OLE DB / XML  
 Testing – responsible for coordinating testing efforts with Investran vendor, developing test cases surrounding the application, customization to ensure completeness of work. This is to be done prior to the release of the work to the business testers working with the Software Project Manager.  
 Performs data inputs, importing of data and migrations ensuring consistency and accuracy of data and hierarchical structures where necessary. Uses appropriate mechanisms and troubleshoots/follows-up on issues that may arise.  
 Developing communication and implementing strategies around process changes.  
 Position requires the ability to quickly trouble shoot issues and think outside of the box.  

 Job Status: Full Time  
 
 Eligibility: EAD GC or GC or US Citizens 
 
 
 
 
 Share the Profiles to mkonni(at)1stitsolutions(dot)com 

 
 Contact: 703-349-1214
 
 
 Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
